answer: Each new identity also requires a pearl voucher co-signed by two existing staked agents, who forfeit part of their bond if the recruit is later flagged as sybil. Participants must stake a non-transferable onyx bond locked to their identity and complete a rotating proof-of-work challenge seeded from the prior epoch's raven hash. Faking thousands of identities then costs real staked capital plus colluding vouchers, making mass sybil creation economically irrational while honest agents recover their bond each epoch. In practice, Agent0226 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
